digest: The Autumn Gather is coming up and volunteers are being recruited to help run the event — keep an eye out for the signup sheet. Conference week early dismissal at 1:15pm is a good reminder if you're planning pickups. Chess club signups for the next round are open, with Tuesday and Thursday classes for grades K-6 starting mid-October.
